title: canarium edule
intro: Canarium edule, commonly known as Pili, is a tree species native to Southeast Asia, particularly in the Philippines and Malaysia. It is valued for its edible nuts, seeds, and oil, which possess numerous health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Canarium edule include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate various health conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and skin problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and fatty acids, which contribute to its medicinal and health-promoting effects.
